note: Since 2.2 a local bound to a call and exported by name resolves by F-Call, as the single declarator does, through any chain of const aliases (L7.7). It is not F-Eval-Ident re-folding the initializer, which has no rule for a call. pair and its alias again are one call resolved once (F-Count), so the build invokes two factories, Stack and makePair.
